Schnittstelle Comparer<A>

Typparameter:
A - the type of values to compare
Alle Superschnittstellen:
BiFunction<A, A, Comparer.Relation>, Fun2<A, A, Comparer.Relation>
Funktionsschnittstelle:
Dies ist eine funktionale Schnittstelle, die somit als Zuweisungsziel für einen Lambdaausdruck oder eine Methodenreferenz verwendet werden kann.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Comparer<A> extends Fun2<A, A, Comparer.Relation>

A functional interface defining comparison logic between two values of the same type. It returns a well-defined Comparer.Relation enum instead of raw integers, restricting outcomes to LESS, EQUAL, or GREATER and making the result suitable for switch-expressions.

Contract: unless stated otherwise, inputs must not be null and results must not be null.

Seit:
1.0.0

  • Methodendetails

    • comparer

      static <A> Comparer<A> comparer(@NonNull Comparator<A> comparator)

      Creates a Comparer from a standard Comparator. Maps compare results to Comparer.Relation via sign semantics, enabling ergonomic use in switch-expressions.

      Contract: comparator must not be null; inputs provided to the returned comparator must not be null.

      Typparameter:
      A - the value type
      Parameter:
      comparator - a standard Comparator; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a Comparer delegating to the given comparator
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if comparator is null
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • compare

      @Pure @NonNull Comparer.Relation compare(@NonNull A first, @NonNull A second)

      Compares two values and returns a Comparer.Relation describing their order.

      Contract: first and second must not be null.

      Parameter:
      first - the first value to compare; must not be null
      second - the second value to compare; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      the comparison outcome as Comparer.Relation
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if any argument is null
      Seit:

    • apply

      @Pure default @NonNull Comparer.Relation apply(@NonNull A first, @NonNull A second)

      Applies this comparator to the given values and returns a Comparer.Relation. Ensures both inputs are non-null before delegating to compare(Object, Object).
